assessment:
STATUS: COMPLETE
SEVERITY: S2

- **Service:** checkout-api — tier 1, owned by **payments** (on-call: payments-oncall@northwind.example)
- **Severity & matrix row:** S2 — "a tier-1 or tier-2 service is degraded for many users." Checkout is erroring on all payment requests, which degrades a tier-1 service for every shopper, but the report shows failures (errors), not money or data loss, so it doesn't meet the S1 row.
- **Has this happened before?** Yes, this pattern matches **INC-2098** (S2, 2026-08-02): elevated 5xx on the charge endpoint after a deploy shipped a connection-pool regression — resolved by rollback. A weaker match is **INC-2041** (S1, 2026-07-14): card authorisation timeouts caused by the payment provider's certificate rotation.

Suggested next steps for the responders: check whether a deploy preceded the 10:00 UTC onset (as in INC-2098) and check payment provider status (as in INC-2041). Escalate to payments-oncall; if errors turn out to be silently dropping charges rather than failing them, this escalates to S1.
customer_note:
**Checkout service disruption**

Checkout is currently erroring on all payment requests, which means shoppers cannot complete purchases. This started around 10:00 UTC and affects all customers; failed payments are returning an error, and we have no indication that any money or data has been lost. We're sorry for the disruption — our team is investigating whether a recent release caused the problem and is also checking with our payment provider. We'll share another update as soon as we know more.
